## Royal Time Elemental (CR 17)

**XP** 102,400  
 Large elemental (elemental, extraplanar, time)  
 **Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +39  

**Defense**

 **AC** 27, touch 21, flat-footed 21 (+5 Dex, +1dodge, +6 insight, +6 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 336 (24d10+96)  
 **Fort** +14; **Ref** +21 ; **Will** +22  
 **Defensive Abilities** foresight; **DR** 15/—; **Immune** elemental  

**Offense**

 **Speed** fly 20 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** 2 slams +29 (2d6+5 plus cell death)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** alter age 2/day (Fort DC 26), multimanifestation, temporal displacement 3/day (24 minutes, Fort DC 26)  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 24th):  

  1/day—summon time elementals (9th level, 1d4 common time elementals, 70%, or 1–2 noble time elementals 30%), time stop (DC 21)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 20, **Con** 18, **Int** 22, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 20  
 **Base Atk** +24; **CMB** +30Z; **CMD** 51  
 **Feats** Cleave, Combat Expertise, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Flyby Attack, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (slam), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (slam)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (slam); Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +29, Diplomacy +29, Fly +38, Intimidate +29, Knowledge (arcana) +33, Knowledge (history) +33, Knowledge (local) +33, Knowledge (planes) +33, Perception +39, Sense Motive +33, Stealth +28, Survival +33  
 **Languages** telepathy 100 ft.  
 **SQ** time jaunt (DC 26)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Alter Age (Su)** Once per day, a noble time elemental can age a creature simply by touching it (this requires a melee touch attack). If successful, the target must succeed on a Fortitude save or advance forward one aging step (from adulthood to middle age, from middle age to old, from old to venerable, and so on). If a character ages, he takes all the effects to his physical ability scores, but does not gain any of the bonuses to his mental ability scores. A venerable creature affected by this ability dies (from massive cell death) and cannot be restored to life by mortal magic. The save DC is Constitution-based.
